SELECT ifnull(f.module_code, tmp.module_code) AS moduleCode, ifnull(t2.module_name, tmp.module_name) AS moduleName, f.field_code AS dimCode, f.white_paper_code AS whitePaperCode, f.dim_code AS dimRealCode, ifnull(t2.dim_name, tmp.dim_name) AS dimName, case when f.data_auth_mode = 'no_cfg_all' and tmp.item_code is null or trim(tmp.item_code) = '' then '-9999' else tmp.item_code end AS itemCode,
case when f.data_auth_mode = 'no_cfg_all' and tmp.item_value is null or trim(tmp.item_value) = '' then '所有' else tmp.item_value end AS itemValue, f.data_auth_mode as authMode, f.field_code as fieldCode FROM ssd_field_auth_dim f left join bi_portal.sys_data_auth_cfg t2 on f.module_code = t2.module_code and f.dim_code = t2.dim_code and t2.is_active = 1 left join ( select tmp1.user_name, tmp1.module_code, tmp1.module_name, tmp1.dim_code, tmp1.dim_name, tmp1.item_code, tmp1.item_value from ( SELECT t1.`owner_id` AS user_name, t1.`module_code`, t1.`module_name`, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value FROM bi_portal.`sys_data_auth` t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.`owner_type` = 'User' AND t1.`owner_id` = #{userName} AND t1.`module_code` = 'ssm_row' AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t1.active_duration_days DAY)
UNION ALL SELECT t2.user_name, t1.`module_code`, t1.`module_name`, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value FROM bi_portal.`sys_data_auth` t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role t2 ON t1.`owner_id` = t2.role_id AND t2.user_name = #{userName} WHERE 1=1 AND t2.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t2.active_duration_days DAY) AND t1.`owner_type` = 'Role' AND t1.`module_code` = 'ssm_row'
UNION ALL SELECT '${userName}' as user_name, t1.`module_code`, t1.`module_name`, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 WHERE t1.owner_type= 'Dept' AND CONCAT(#{deptId}, '/') LIKE CONCAT('%', t1.owner_id, '/%') AND t1.`module_code` = 'ssm_row' AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t1.active_duration_days DAY) ) tmp1 group by tmp1.user_name, tmp1.module_code, tmp1.module_name, tmp1.dim_code, tmp1.dim_name, tmp1.item_code, tmp1.item_value ) tmp ON tmp.module_code = f.`module_code` AND tmp.dim_code = f.`dim_code` WHERE 1=1 AND f.`module_code` = 'ssm_row'
and tmp.item_value like concat('%', #{searchText} ,'%')
LIMIT ${pageRowLower}, ${prePageSize} order by moduleCode, dimCode, itemCode

select count(1) as f_count from ( SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t1.`owner_id` AS user_name, t1.`module_code`, t1.`module_name`, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value FROM bi_portal.`sys_data_auth` t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.`owner_type` = 'User' AND t1.`owner_id` = #{userName} AND t1.`module_code` NOT IN('ssd_field') AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t1.active_duration_days DAY) UNION ALL SELECT t2.user_name, t1.`module_code`, t1.`module_name`, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value FROM bi_portal.`sys_data_auth` t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role t2 ON t1.`owner_id` = t2.role_id AND t2.user_name = #{userName} WHERE 1=1 AND t2.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t2.active_duration_days DAY) AND t1.`owner_type` = 'Role' AND t1.`module_code` NOT IN('ssd_field') ) tmp INNER JOIN ssd_field_auth_dim f ON tmp.module_code = f.`module_code` AND tmp.dim_code = f.`dim_code` WHERE 1=1 AND f.`module_code` NOT IN('ssd_field')
and tmp.item_value like concat('%', #{searchText} ,'%')
LIMIT ${pageRowLower}, ${prePageSize} order by moduleCode, dimCode, itemCode ) tmp2

SELECT t1.exp_begin_time AS startTime, t1.exp_end_time AS endTime, '多维分析' AS source, '下载' AS eventType, t1.USER_NAME AS userName, t2.dept1_name AS firstlySector, t2.dept2_name AS secondarySector, t2.dept3_name AS thirdSector, t1.query_config AS filterInfo, t1.exp_rows AS rowCount, t3.field_title AS sensitiveField, t3.sensitive_type AS dataType, IF ( t3.field_title IS NULL, '', 'C4' ) AS sensitiveLevel, CASE t1.exp_success WHEN '1' THEN 'success' ELSE 'failed' END AS status, 'bi_selfhelp_log' AS tags FROM bi_portal.ssd_query_exp_log t1 LEFT JOIN bi_portal.hr_employee t2 ON t1.USER_NAME = t2.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f.log_id, group_concat( d.field_title ) AS field_title, group_concat( DISTINCT d.sensitive_type ) AS sensitive_type FROM bi_portal.ssd_query_field_log f LEFT JOIN ssd_field_def d ON find_in_set( d.field_id, f.field_id ) WHERE d.sensitive_type is not null and f.log_id = #{logId} GROUP BY f.log_id ) t3 ON t1.exp_id = t3.log_id WHERE t1.`exp_id` = #{logId}
